question: Related Questions Q. I want to know what is the ruling for missing Sunnah-e-Muwakkadah namaz after obligatory prayers. 2757 views Q. Assalaam Alaikum. My question is that if I have joined the Jamaat in Fourth Rakah in Zuhar prayer, and after offering Salaam by Imam, in which sequence will I recite the Surah other than Surah Fatiha in order to complete my prayer? 2835 views Q. In salat if change sequence of surah in 2 rakat is it OK?(In 1st rakat ' Kul huwallhu ahad???? and second rakat 'Alam tar kif???" or if it is not OK did we have to do sajda e sahu (obligatery sajda)? 4131 views Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. i would like to know how many wajibaat's are there in namaaz. i have read some books but they are different from each other so please help me.. 3307 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10935 Country: India Title: ASSLAMU ALYCUM 1. COLLECTIVE DUA AFTER SALLATT IS SUNNATH OR BEDUATH, EXPLINE WITH HADEES. 2.SHAKE HAND(MUSSAFATH) WITH ONE OR TWO HAND WHICH IS SUNNATH. 3.REALESTATE BUSSINESS (SELLINGLAND)IS ALLOWABLE. Question: ASSLAMU ALYCUM 1. COLLECTIVE DUA AFTER SALLATT IS SUNNATH OR BEDUATH, EXPLINE WITH HADEES. 2.SHAKE HAND(MUSSAFATH) WITH ONE OR TWO HAND WHICH IS SUNNATH. 3.REALESTATE BUSSINESS (SELLINGLAND)IS ALLOWABLE. Answer ID: 10935 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 235/235=M/1430) Praying after salah is proved from hadith, but it is wrong to consider collective dua necessary and revile those who do not do so. Everyone needs dua and has been asked to supplicate, so there is no wrong if seemingly it looks like collective. (2) Shaking hand is mustahab (desirable) with both hands. (3) It is lawful if no unlawful thing takes place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
